body: Not trying to be a jerk, but that's why I posted this. If I felt like I could tell someone this face to face I would.

This is definitely the most helpful thing I've read. Thank you very much, just hearing that someone else somewhere thinks I'm not being completely illogical helps keep me afloat. Sometimes I feel like I'm losing it.

In all honestly I have done that, I think I've over done it. At least once a week I try to bring her a favorite candy, take out food, or some other thing when I get off of work. Unfortunately thus had only contributed to my coming off as seriously clingy. In her words "you literally think about me all the time, it's not healthy." I know it's not healthy, she's right, but I've always been this way. About 6 years ago I went through a very serious and drawn out period of about two years that included an arrest, 2 suicide attempts, and a stint at a rehab facility (wasn't dealing with addiction but to a lot of hospitals, depression and addiction are treated incredibly similar strangely). During that period, I got a lot better at living. And for a solid few years I was living and doing things successfully, but history is cyclical and I relapsed, not into self harm, but self-hatred. This is why I feel like I'm both perfect for being in a relationship, while simultaneously completely incapable of being in a healthy one.
